title: Jubilant Dutch Potato Fritters
description: A spicy and springy Dutch dish featuring Appleton rum, these lacto-vegetarian-friendly fritters are a crowd-pleaser. They are double-fried for a crispy exterior and a fluffy interior.
instructions: Combine grated potatoes, flour, Appleton rum, chopped onion, minced garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Mix well to combine, then stir in eggs and milk until a thick batter forms.
Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the potato batter into the hot oil, being careful not to overcrowd the pan.
Double-fry the fritters by frying them for 2-3 minutes, then removing them from the oil and letting them cool for 30 seconds before frying again for an additional 2 minutes.
Repeat the frying process until all the batter is used up, adjusting the heat as necessary to prevent burning.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
